admission_and_review_gates: Before executing, authenticate campaign/parent/source/progress/producer pins and unchanged stat witnesses; require absent output destination and stopped parent lock/no WAL.
Pin the new owner code/schema and all normalization/ID recipes in a new manifest. Keep the frozen archived-target generation unchanged.
Use the existing resource guardian for one fresh locked named-root admission census with the entire requested storage reservation charged; refuse if insufficient.
Acquire only the run's own one-CPU/one-child/1536MiB scheduler lease under the unchanged scheduler policy; record lease/process birth/group custody.
Count DB, shards, indexes, staging and every report/custody receipt against the hard logical output/guardian caps. Do not assume compression ratios or subtract foreign retained claims.
Bound complete-section hydration to 8MiB and preserve the accepted 64-valid-document historical ordinal replay. Refuse oversized candidates before advancing the cursor.

Independent stopped review must reconstruct raw/source-location custody and all identity rows under different page sizes, compare historical IDs and ordered accounting digests, and qualify full-source uniqueness only after exhaustion.
Require stopped process group, successful own claim/lease release, exact preexisting foreign-record preservation and attribution of legitimate concurrent additions.
Scale only after measuring bytes per identity/pair/index, time per page and process-lifetime self high-water; reduce page count or stop when admission/output/time bounds refuse.
Training, distillation, registry import and model publication remain later, separate family/dimension/schema/task gates using retained eligible assets.

query_snapshot.archive_metadata_cohorts:
SELECT a.status,f.source_span_id IS NOT NULL AS exact_id_joined,count(*) AS rows,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.source_sha256 IS NULL) AS sha_null,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.source_sha256='') AS sha_empty,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.source_sha256<>'' AND trim(a.source_sha256)='') AS sha_whitespace_only,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_full_match(a.source_sha256,'[0-9a-f]{64}')) AS sha_valid_plain_hex,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.legal_id IS NULL) AS legal_null,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.legal_id='') AS legal_empty,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.legal_id<>'' AND trim(a.legal_id)='') AS legal_whitespace_only,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(trim(a.source_sha256),'')<>'' AND coalesce(trim(a.legal_id),'')<>'') AS both_fields_present,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_full_match(a.source_sha256,'[0-9a-f]{64}') AND coalesce(trim(a.legal_id),'')<>'') AS plain_hash_and_legal_present,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.source_span_id IS NOT NULL AND a.source_sha256=f.source_sha256) AS joined_hash_equal,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.source_span_id IS NOT NULL AND a.legal_id=f.legal_id) AS joined_legal_equal,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.source_span_id IS NOT NULL AND a.source_sha256=f.source_sha256 AND a.legal_id=f.legal_id) AS joined_pair_equal
 FROM archive a LEFT JOIN final.target_occurrences f ON f.source_span_id=a.source_span_id
 WHERE a.record_kind='span' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
query_snapshot.bounded_nonempty_hash_examples: SELECT status,source_span_id,source_sha256,legal_id,code_identity FROM archive WHERE record_kind='span' AND coalesce(trim(source_sha256),'')<>'' ORDER BY source_span_id LIMIT 8
query_snapshot.bounded_unresolved_pair_examples: WITH pairs AS (SELECT legal_id,source_sha256,count(*) AS physical_occurrences,count(DISTINCT source_span_id) AS distinct_ids,min(source_span_id) AS example_source_span_id,min(source_section_offset) AS example_section FROM final.target_occurrences GROUP BY 1,2), unresolved AS (SELECT a.* FROM archive a WHERE record_kind='span' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final.target_occurrences f WHERE f.source_span_id=a.source_span_id)) SELECT u.source_span_id AS archived_id,u.source_sha256,u.legal_id,u.status AS archived_status,p.physical_occurrences,p.distinct_ids,p.example_source_span_id,p.example_section FROM unresolved u JOIN pairs p USING(legal_id,source_sha256) ORDER BY u.source_span_id LIMIT 16
query_snapshot.target_stats: SELECT count(*) AS rows,count(DISTINCT source_span_id) AS span_ids,count(DISTINCT legal_id) AS legal_ids,count(DISTINCT (legal_id,source_sha256)) AS legal_hash_pairs,min(source_section_offset) AS first_section,max(source_section_offset) AS last_section,min(source_section_span_ordinal) AS min_local_ordinal,max(source_section_span_ordinal) AS max_local_ordinal,sum(utf8_bytes) AS normalized_span_bytes,min(utf8_bytes) AS min_utf8_bytes,max(utf8_bytes) AS max_utf8_bytes FROM final.target_occurrences
query_snapshot.unresolved_vs_persisted_target_pairs: WITH pairs AS (SELECT legal_id,source_sha256,count(*) AS physical_occurrences,count(DISTINCT source_span_id) AS distinct_ids,min(source_span_id) AS example_source_span_id,min(source_section_offset) AS example_section FROM final.target_occurrences GROUP BY 1,2), unresolved AS (SELECT a.* FROM archive a WHERE record_kind='span' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM final.target_occurrences f WHERE f.source_span_id=a.source_span_id)) SELECT u.status,count(*) AS unresolved_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(trim(u.source_sha256),'')<>'' AND coalesce(trim(u.legal_id),'')<>'') AS fields_present,count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.legal_id IS NOT NULL) AS recorded_pair_matches_persisted_target,count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.physical_occurrences=1) AS unique_physical_target_pair,count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.physical_occurrences>1) AS ambiguous_target_pair FROM unresolved u LEFT JOIN pairs p USING(legal_id,source_sha256) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

execution.bounded_metadata_query_note: Two preliminary read-only queries refused before any metadata scan (unknown column; unsupported ATTACH parameter syntax). Corrected bounded diagnostic completed; no state changes or spill occurred.

findings: All 443,904 archived span rows have a nonblank legal_id and a valid plain 64-hex source_sha256. Missing/null/empty/whitespace-only metadata is not the explanation for the unresolved rows.
All 64,969 existing exact-ID joins agree with recorded source_sha256 and legal_id: 62,001 gap records and 2,968 sealed records.

Against the complete 64,969-row persisted target subset, 3,700 unresolved archive rows match a recorded legal_id/source_sha256 pair: 1,192 singleton physical-target pairs and 2,508 ambiguous target pairs. Singleton status is relative to that subset only.
Of those pair hits, gaps contribute 3,699 (1,191 singleton, 2,508 ambiguous); sealed rows contribute one singleton. 375,235 unresolved rows have no pair match in the persisted target subset.
The earlier zero-hit seed result concerned only source sections 0..127 and remains correct within that scope.
Persisted targets contain 54,915 distinct legal/hash pairs, including 3,537 repeated pairs and a maximum of 73 physical occurrences per pair. Repeated short content weakens location recovery.
Source exhaustion does not provide a full-source identity table: 3,776,019 outside-target occurrence identities remain aggregate-only. Their ordered digest and bounded examples are retained.
The recorded historical source total differs from the completed generation by 1,654 occurrences; no cause is authenticated by this survey.

The latest finalized guardian census has 674,809,450 bytes of named-root headroom, while the current unchanged ledger preserves 99 retained foreign claims totaling 47,965,000,000 bytes. This stale census is not an admission authorization.

immediate_metadata_only_diagnostic_plan.scope: Next root-owned guarded diagnostic; distinct from the later source-identity paging proposal.

low_information_content_diagnostics.interpretation: Exact digest equality to a known UTF-8 literal is a low-information content cohort, not a missing-field or placeholder verdict. It does not authenticate unknown archive text or a physical occurrence.

GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

recommended_initial_source_only_pilot.completion: Commit bounded complete identity pages into a new owned generation, including outsider identities. Preserve cursor/count/digests and sampled usage for a stopped independent review.
recommended_initial_source_only_pilot.purpose: Measure complete-source row storage/index amplification and recipe/pair diagnostics; no model/embedding/tokenizer/IR training or proof.
recommended_initial_source_only_pilot.runtime_estimate_limit: Previously measured paging fits these memory/CPU limits, but a new full-row owner and index schema have no measured duration. The deadline and output cap must stop safely at the last committed cursor.

refusal_policy: Never promote an alias, ready record, teacher label or proof from a metadata-only pair hit.
Refuse missing/invalid SHA, empty legal ID, mismatched original source/revision/recipe pins, normalized-text digest disagreement or incomplete raw-source custody.
Refuse physical ambiguity across all candidate locations; uniqueness within the retained-target subset or a pilot prefix is insufficient.
Keep the archived ID and each proposed alternate recipe ID distinct until the actual historical producer is authenticated.
Preserve every candidate and its multiplicity; repeated short fragments, identical legal/hash pairs and changed ordinal regimes require explicit qualification.
While source paging remains incomplete, label unseen-source uniqueness as pending rather than unique.
Refuse use of metadata/null-CID or legacy citation fallback as statutory text.
Do not release, reset or shrink any foreign disk reservation or scheduler lease to admit this work.

source_identity_inventory_design.archive_pair_catalog: Index recorded legal_id+source_sha256 to all physical candidate locations, with counts and distinct locations. Do not select MIN, first occurrence, nearest ordinal or an arbitrary generated ID.
source_identity_inventory_design.legacy_fallback: Preserve historical fallback ordinal behavior and label citation/law-name fallback provenance explicitly. Fallback text is not eligible statutory raw-text or semantic authority.
source_identity_inventory_design.model_linkage: Link existing embeddings/checkpoints only after exact text custody and original producer/tokenizer/normalization/encoder/task/schema eligibility. IR family, schema/version, decoder task and 8D/384D/768D model profiles remain separate inventories.
source_identity_inventory_design.physical_occurrence_key: Domain-separated digest of pinned source artifact/revision, physical row and local sentence index plus extraction/normalization profile. Keep it distinct from context-dependent archived/generated span IDs.
source_identity_inventory_design.raw_span_offset_contract: If raw byte/character offsets or whitespace alignment are persisted, qualify an explicit reversible mapping algorithm and independently check that replaying each raw slice produces the exact normalized span SHA/bytes. Otherwise leave raw-span offsets unqualified/null and bind through the source row, local ordinal, pinned extraction and raw-document digest.
source_identity_inventory_design.reuse: Reference frozen original source/progress artifacts, accepted parent target rows, old full seed rows and their receipts, and pinned normalization/pager owners. Do not regenerate model embeddings or copy the laws blob.

compact_fixed_width_floor.exclusions: Section dictionary, pair indexes, DB pages, shard headers, manifests, staging, duplicate copies and raw-offset maps; fixed-width assumptions must be measured in the pilot.

storage_estimates.interpretation: A full 20-column source table is poorly supported by the present sub-675MB named-root headroom. A compact binary-hash/sharded design may fit but has not been measured. Full-run admission must follow actual pilot storage/index measurements and fresh guardian accounting.

retained_target_db.scope: Extrapolation from a 20-column target-only DuckDB with duplicate strings/index overhead; not a prediction for a compact new schema.
